title: CRINGELAND - a Vanilla+
description:
Animations, gestures, inventory sorting, quality of life. No maps or radars - vanilla balance.
Not affiliated with the brand of the same name (if there is one). Simply a build for its own circle.
body:
## **Cringeland: Vanilla+ (for friends only)**

**We don't claim to be official.** If "Cringeland" is someone's registered trademark, we apologize; we just named the server that way among friends.

**What's inside:**
- ✨ Animations and gestures — wave to a friend or show them they're awesome, even without voice control.
- 📦 Inventory and chest sorting — it's hard to play vanilla without this.
- 🔧 Crafting from adjacent slots — no need to run for every stick.
- 👋 Information about player connections.
- ⚖️ Full vanilla balance: the same number of mobs, endermen don't fly through walls, and damage doesn't fluctuate.

**No maps, minimaps, or cheat mods.** Only things that don't break gameplay but make it more enjoyable.

> *Not commercial, not an official release. Just a build for a select group.*

This build includes **mods**, **resource packs**, and **shader packs** for **Fabric 1.21.11**.
Below is the full list (the build includes files marked `.disabled`, but they are disabled; I'll mark them).

---

## 🔧 Mods (active)

### Optimization and Graphics
- **Sodium** – render optimization, higher FPS.
- **Iris** – shaders.
- **Sodium Extra** + **Reese's Sodium Options** – additional graphics settings.
- **ImmediatelyFast** – speeds up rendering.
- **Entity Culling** – prevents invisible entities from being drawn.
- **More Culling** – additional edge culling.
- **Dynamic FPS** – reduces background FPS.
- **Voxy** / **Voxy Extra** – improved chunk loading.
- **Better FPS – Rabbit Pathfinding Fix** – rabbit AI optimization.
- **VMP (Very Many Players)** – server optimization.

### Animations and Appearance
- **Not Enough Animations** – smooth animations for items in hand, walking, etc.
- **FirstPerson** – improved first-person hand animations.
- **PlayerAnimationLib** + **BendableCuboids** – skeletal player animations.
- **Emotecraft** – gestures and emotes.
- **ChatAnimation** – message appearance animation.
- **Eating Animation** (resource pack, but related to animations) – eating animation.
- **Skin Layers 3D** – volumetric skin layers.
- **BetterGrassify** – improved grass.
- **Continuity** – connected textures (OptiFine style).
- **Polytone** – dynamic block lighting.

### Quality of Life (Client)
- **Mouse Tweaks** – Easily move items with the mouse.
- **Lightweight Inventory Sorting** – Sorting your inventory with a button.
- **ClickThrough Plus** – Click through signs/frames to access chests.
- **Held Item Info** – Shows the name of the item in your hand.
- **BetterStats** – Advanced statistics.
- **BetterF3** – Informative F3 without clutter.
- **Status Effect Bars** – Effect bars above the inventory.
- **Chat Heads** – Player heads in chat.
- **No Chat Reports** – Disables chat telemetry.
- **No Telemetry** – Disables Mojang analytics.
- **Dark Loading Screen** – Dark loading screen.
- **SmoothScroll** – Smooth scrolling.
- **Camera Obscura** / **Camerapture** – improved screenshots.
- **Image2Map** – uploading images to maps.
- **Signed Paintings** – signatures on paintings.
- **Better Advancements** – tree-like achievement window.
- **Resourcify** – convenient resource pack management.
- **Mod Menu** – mod list.
- **MidnightLib** / **Cloth Config** / **YetAnotherConfigLib** / **owo-lib** – settings libraries.
- **Puzzle** – improved resource pack GUI.
- **Debugify** – fixes minor vanilla bugs.

### Server/shared mods (work on both client and server)
- **Fabric API** – foundation.
- **Fabric Language Kotlin** – for mods written in Kotlin.
- **Architectury** – cross-platform library.
- **Polymer (bundled)** – allows the server to send custom items/blocks without a mod on the client (synchronization).
- **Trinkets** – accessory slots.
- **Useful Hats** – functional hats.
- **MyTotemDoll** – a totem shaped like a player figurine.
- **WeaponMaster** – minor combat improvements.
- **Trade** – improved merchants.
- **Controlify** – gamepad support.
- **Radio** – in-game music radio.
- **VoiceChat** – voice chat (Simple Voice Chat).
- **BeautifiedChat (client+server)** – beautiful chat.
- **Styled Player List** – a stylized player list (Tab).
- **WelcomeMessage** – a welcome message upon login.
- **EasyWhitelist** – simple whitelist management.
- **BetterServerPacks** – automatic resource pack synchronization.
- **ResourcePackChecker** – resource pack checker on the server.
- **ServerCore** – server optimization.
- **Collective** – library for mods.
- **Player Drop Heads** – players drop heads.
- **Better Server Sleep** – improved sleep (can one player skip a night?).
- **Async Pack Scan** – asynchronous pack scanning.
- **Fast IP Ping** – fast server ping.
- **LibJF** / **TCDCommons** / **CWB** / **Placeholder API** – libraries.

### Miscellaneous
- **Take a Seat** – sit on steps/half-blocks.
- **Presence Footsteps** – different footstep sounds on blocks.
- **LambDynamicLights** – dynamic light sources (torch in hand).
- **Subtle Effects** – small visual effects.
- **Particle Rain** – rain particles on blocks.
- **Chunks Fade In** – smooth chunk appearance.
- **Shoulder Surfing** – over-the-shoulder camera (3rd person).
- **Bedrock Coordinates** – shows coordinates like in Bedrock.
- **Clumps** – groups XP orbs.
- **Effectual** – improved visual effects.
- **CIT List** / **CIT Variations** – support for custom item textures.
- **Entity Texture Features** – random mob textures.
- **Visual Workbench** – workbench animation.
- **Female Gender Mod** – female character model.
- **FabricMail** – in-game mail.

---

## 🎨 Resource Packs (active)
- **FreshAnimations** – new creature animations.
- **Fresh Moves (No Animated Eyes)** – player animations.
- **LOLCOT** – as the name suggests, a local resource pack.
- **Unique Dark – Lite** – dark UI.
- **Enchantment Glows** – recolors the glow of enchantments.
- **Minimal Armor** – thinner armor.
- **Icons Additions** / **Icons Fix** / **Waxed Icons** – item icons.
- **Night Vision Fix** – removes the green effect of night vision.
- **Clear Weather** – removes clouds/rain.
- **Animated Loading Screen – Monochrome Logo** – animated loading screen.
- **Better Fall Drop 2025 Panorama** – new menu background.
- **Vanilla texture fix** – vanilla texture fixes.
- **HWH-ZombieTemplate** – texture template.
- **InfinityCrosshair** – crosshair.
- **TooManyRenames** – many renamed textures.
- **Controlify Dungeons** – gamepad resource pack.
- **HMI Item Position Fix** – item position fixes.
- **Fresh Environment** – environment.
- **Megumin** – likely a skin/icon.
- **Eating Animation** – food animation.

---

## 🌓 Shaderpacks
- **PSX-Core** – PS1 style.
- **TAA Project** – anti-aliasing.
- **Body Camera Shader** – body camera effect.

---

## ❌ Disabled (files with `.disabled` in the build)
Mods don't load, but are located in the following folder:
- Ksyxis
- Music Sync
- Screenshot Copy
- ServerPingerFixer
- WorldPlayTime
- WaterPlayer
- HMI (Haven't Met You)
- ToadLib
- SpawnAnimations
- Animated Logo
- TitleFixer
- TIA (Too Many Items?)
- VolumeFix

(They don't affect the game; they can be ignored or deleted.)
